caseNameFull: Chin Ying Don v. George B. Billings, United States Commissioner, etc.
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the District of Massachusetts.
attorneys: Mr. Warren Ozro Kyle for the appellants., The Attorney General, The Solicitor General and Mr. Assistant Attorney General Harr for the appellee.

opinions.text: Dismissed with costs, on authority of counsel for the appellant, on motion of Mr. Solicitor General Lehmann for the appellee.
